recent.text: Zaccharie Risacher had 15 points and a team-high eight rebounds starting in place of P.J. Washington. He said Dallas needed to be “a bit more physical” getting through screens against Svi Mykhailiuk. Read more on @DALSportsJrnl: https://t.co/KKCEC4FFs0
recent.author: Grant Afseth

recent.text: Caleb Martin is 16-of-30 from 3 this season after making three of five in Utah. His approach when the ball finds him is “just taking the open ones.” Read more on @DALSportsJrnl: https://t.co/gm4Ca1XQkM
recent.author: Grant Afseth

recent.text: Cooper Flagg said Kyrie Irving makes the easy pass when defenses load up on him. Irving set up eight of Flagg’s 28 points in Utah. “He probably deserved 10 or 12,” Dusty May said of Irving’s eight assists. Read more on @DALSportsJrnl: https://t.co/sHuUP0ZdIZ

recent.text: Cooper Flagg called his late inbound turnover “a bad pass, but the right idea.” Utah tied it on the next possession, and Flagg made both winning free throws with 3.6 seconds left. Read more on @DALSportsJrnl: https://t.co/ihJkCKPiy0
recent.author: Grant Afseth

recent.text: Dusty May said the Mavericks are “still in our development phase” as he explained giving the reserves a chance to close in Utah. Dallas was up 18 when Cooper Flagg sat and up five when he and Kai returned. Read more on @DALSportsJrnl: https://t.co/9EwBuXj61k
recent.author: Grant Afseth

recent.text: Cooper Flagg said the Mavericks “gotta be smarter and take up some of the clock” late in games. Dallas took an early 3 on its first trip after going up 16 and later had a shot-clock violation. That’s one of six takeaways from Utah. Read more on @DALSportsJrnl:
recent.author: Grant Afseth

recent.text: The Mavericks led by 16 with 2:14 left in Utah. The Jazz tied it before Cooper Flagg made both free throws with 3.6 seconds left to give Dallas a 116-114 win. “We just got complacent,” Flagg said. Read more on @DALSportsJrnl: https://t.co/swTE8eWkHQ
recent.author: Grant Afseth

recent.text: Asked Dusty May about the biggest factors that went into the 4th quarter meltdown. He admitted that subbing Flagg & Irving out of the game too early was the most obvious one. “We want to play guys more minutes. We’re still in our development phase, not just “win this game right https://t.co/uJ5k0NZqpI

recent.text: Flagg just had an opportunity to throw down his fifth dunk of the night, but missed. He's been attacking the rim all night.
recent.author: Mike Curtis

recent.text: The Mavs are in full control of this game after Flagg just muscled Bailey and made an acrobatic reverse layup through contact. Dallas leads 80-62 with 5:24 left in the third.

recent.text: Another poster for Cooper Flagg. After dunking on Brook Lopez last night, he just added Svi Mykhailuk to his list of victims. After the dunk, Flagg mean-mugged Svi.
